headline: Co4E Workflow — the visual, node-based automation builder — accounts for 14 tickets, all marked released in the tracker; code evidence directly backs 7 of them, and the remaining 7 could not be confirmed from the portion of the code examined.
what_is_there: The code shows a working visual workflow studio: a drag-and-drop canvas with zoom and connections, an engine that runs the connected steps in dependency order and passes each step's output into the next, fan-out to multiple sub-agents with a join stage, user-defined agent personas for steps, automatic self-verification rounds with a configurable limit, and run history with progress tracking that survives restarts.
what_is_unclear: The analysis could not confirm the specific node types (IF/Switch, Join, Start, End), conditional branch gating and skipping, the Auto/Plan/Manual run modes, the permission presets, workflow import/export between instances, or the newer request to attach a folder or URL to a step — mostly because the core workflow definition module and step configuration screen were not among the files read. Several searches also returned an unrelated model-routing "switch" feature, which added noise rather than evidence.
suggested_action: Ask the team to point the analysis at the core workflow definition module and the step configuration panel, then re-run the check on the seven unconfirmed tickets.
